title: feat(app-shell): Studio opens an off-nav list view on its object's page, lists only views no dropdown reaches, and reads form views as forms
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgXkTWXsjBzzss3KguAuRzTF)_

domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb5R6JDdfyvtj3dPR2

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 界面里，从「不在导航中 → 视图」打开列表视图，现在落到对象页（标题 对象 / 视图 ▾），条件格式化和视图表单分节一并搬到右侧面板；有导航入口的对象，其列表视图不再重复列在该分组；表单视图显示为「线索表单」这类可读名字，分组标题按内容写「表单视图 / 视图 / 表单视图与列表视图」，表单视图的「视图类型」读出 简单 / 标签页 / 向导，不再是「simple（未找到）」。
- 为什么改：#30046 Scope 6–8（裁定 A，6651738887）。同一个列表视图以前有两个页面、两套面板，导航里已能到达的视图又在「不在导航中」重复出现，表单视图名字是 `crm_lead.form` 这类内部名。
- 风险与回滚：只动 Studio 前端（app-shell 与 studio 语言包三个新键），不动元数据、spec 或服务端。共用的视图检查器只在表单视图上换类型清单，列表视图那一侧不变并有测试钉住。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 `pickOffNav` / `listViewDoorOf` 与离线分组过滤，`ListViewMoreSection.tsx`（新），`ViewVariantInspector.tsx` 的 `useTypeOptions`。
- 两分钟验证：打开示例 CRM 的 Studio → 界面：「不在导航中」只剩「表单视图」4 项；点「线索表单」，视图类型显示「简单」；访问 `?surface=view:crm_lead.pipeline` 落到「线索 / 线索看板」。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 新增三个 i18n 键（Clause-② widening），席位需安排 TIER_DEFAULT 评审；其余无。

Fixes #30046

Clause-②: yes (widening) — three new published `@object-ui/i18n` Studio keys: `engine.studio.if.offNav.viewForms`, `engine.studio.if.offNav.viewMixed`, `engine.studio.if.offNav.formName` (en + zh). No accept set narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none — Studio UI only: no metadata key, spec schema, server route or stored shape is added or read differently; the view items are read through the existing `/meta/view` list (drafts overlaid) and written through the existing list-view draft path.

## What changes

Scope 6–8 of #30046, ruled as option A (6651738887). Scope 1–5 landed in #30175 and are untouched.

- **Scope 6 — a list view opens on its object's page from every door.** Picking a list view under 不在导航中 → 视图, or following a link to the view itself (`?surface=view:OBJECT.KEY`), now lands on the object page with its header dropdown (object / view ▾) on that view: the object's nav entry when it has one, else the object itself with no entry (`?surface=object:OBJECT&view=…`, which a reload or a shared link opens again). The panel there gains `ListViewMoreSection` (new): the view's 条件格式化 (`ConditionalFormattingEditor`, whose CEL verdicts now hold the list-view autosave the way they held the view page's Save) and the spec authoring form's sections for a view, pruned of every key the panel already edits, so no setting has two controls. A form view, and a view a read-only base's pair adds (`addedIn`), still open as themselves. #30039 owns translating those sections.
- **Scope 7 — the 视图 group lists what the dropdowns do not reach.** A list view whose object has a nav entry is no longer listed, a view only drafted in the package included (`withDraftViewBindings` reads the drafted rows' `object`/`viewKind` from the draft-overlaid list, fail-soft). The list views of an object with no entry stay listed. The only-customized filter is unchanged.
- **Scope 8 — form views read as forms.** A form view is listed by its label, else as the object's name plus 表单 ("Lead form", 「线索表单」, with ` · key` for a non-default form); the group's heading says what it holds (表单视图, 视图, or 表单视图与列表视图). In `ViewVariantInspector`, a form view's 视图类型 reads the form-variant schema's `type` enum (simple / tabbed / wizard, labelled with the existing `engine.inspector.pageBlock.option.formType.*` keys) and defaults to `simple`; a list view's picker is byte-for-byte the same roster as before.
- `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`: the hook gains `openView(surface, viewId)`; the panel appends `ListViewMoreSection` as an independent block after the sort block, with no existing section reordered (seat 4's #30089 adds a section in the same render region). #30315's `listViewTargetOf` hunks are not touched. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`'s `restoreOriginal` / `publishNonce` region (#30238) is not touched.

## Tests

- New `InterfacesPillar.offNavListViews-30046.test.tsx` (13 cases): Scope 7 filtering with controls (an object with no entry stays listed, a drafted view included), Scope 8 names and the three headings, Scope 6 object page landing, the panel's 条件格式化 and spec sections, a second pick on the same page, `?surface=object:…&view=` and `?surface=view:…` links with and without an entry, CONTROL that a form view still opens as itself, and the CEL hold (autosave blocked on a bad rule, saved once fixed).
- New `ViewVariantInspector.formViewType-30046.test.tsx` (8 cases, en + zh): a form view reads its layout and offers only the form roster; a form view with no type reads Simple; CONTROL a list view still offers the list types; CONTROL an off-enum list type is still flagged.
- `packageSurfaces.test.ts`: 3 cases for `viewBindingOf` / `withDraftViewBindings`.
- `InterfacesPillar.offNavItems-26889.test.tsx` and `InterfacesPillar.offNavDeepLink-28561.test.tsx`: their off-nav view fixture is now a form view (`web_form`), since a list view of an object with an entry is no longer listed there; what they assert is unchanged.
- Red first: with `origin/main`'s five source files checked out, 17 of the new/changed cases fail (5 files); all pass on this branch.
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`): Scope 7 filter → 3 red; the list-view door → 5 red; the form-type roster pick → 2 red (both locales); the CEL hold term → 1 red.

## Acceptance notes

- Card Acceptance 5, browser checks on both package kinds (branch head before the main merge, which brought no ui change), screenshots in the project files under `ui-seat2/card-30046/screenshots/`:
  - Read-only example CRM (`examples/app-crm`): 不在导航中 lists only 表单视图 (4): 活动表单, 线索表单 · web_to_lead, 线索表单, 商机表单; the default landing panel carries 条件格式化 and 基础信息 below the sort block; `?surface=view:crm_lead.pipeline` lands on 线索 / 线索看板 at `surface=object:crm_lead&nav=nav_leads&view=crm_lead.pipeline`; 线索表单 opens as a form view whose 视图类型 reads 简单.
  - Writable throwaway package (one object with a nav entry, one without, all views drafted): the heading reads 表单视图与列表视图 with Case表单 and Open cases only; the entry object's drafted All tasks / My tasks are absent from the group and present in its header dropdown; Open cases lands on Case / Open cases at `surface=object:ws_case&view=ws_case.open`, survives a reload, and its panel shows the view's CEL rule (CEL 有效).
- Observed, not in this card's scope: the form view inspector's header still reads the item name (`crm_lead.form`), and its spec sections (Layout, Columns, Title) are English in zh, which is #30039's.
- Line budget: 1153 insertions, 41 deletions (1194 changed lines, about half of them tests), under the ~1200 stop.

## Verification

On the final tree (head `9eff7192`, `origin/main` `870ebce3` merged in), every exit code recorded to a file before any pipe:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack <14 changed paths>`: 35 commands, all exit 0 (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped, Tests 4985 passed | 2 skipped). `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0 (and `--self-test` exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n lint`: exit 0, 0 errors (warnings only, existing patterns).
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: exit 0. `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n --concurrency=2` (under `os-verify-lock`): 69/69 tasks, exit 0.
- Targeted re-run after the merge: the five changed/new test files, Test Files 5 passed, Tests 50 passed.
- Before the merge, every test file importing a changed module plus every `InterfacesPillar.*` and `StudioDesignSurface.*` test (167 files): 1220/1221, the one red being the zh lazy-catalogue race in the new inspector test, since fixed (top-level `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`) and green three runs in a row.
